Nothing to say about the greatest game of all time, that Nintendo somehow managed to improve.

game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: jorgeemn
quote: 13 years and billions of dollars. Absolutely underwhelming. Sad to see so many users willing to reward this company for this expensive game. The problem is Rockstar made us expect too much. This type of glitches and bugs on a game that pretends to be extremely realistic simply pops me out of the immersion. This time I have to punish with my review, as I can't just simply let this go as success in this industry.
